purpose: T10 timing as a development binding in Python, recipe reco.timing.time-chain/1 (as decisions.md U12 A for T08 and T09; not a native backend, whose gap stays open), stage 1 (docs/dev/detector-reconstruction/t10-timing-stage-plan.md): the conditions payload timing-payload/1, one per chain step (offset, amplitude-dependent walk, propagation along the counter) keyed by the channel map timing-channel-map/1, with derived payloads that record their source; the time chain of single-ended and two-ended counters with, per hit, the value before and after each step in chain order with its payload identity, the amplitude, both ends' times or the position with its source, and the path length (plan R35), with a reader that refuses a broken chain and recomputes every applied value from its parameter and, given them, the payloads; external, common linear, per-track leave-one-out linear (every hit of the track excluded) and median event times that record source, estimator, hits and weights; time of flight and beta, each TOF naming its event time; and on the scoring side the calibration-interface checks CAI-T10-1 and CAI-T10-2 of plan R37 with planted-defect controls on the check side and the recipe side; synthetic constants only, no timing, TOF or PID quality claim; optional, required by no skill
